title: pastinaca caroli-kochii
intro: Pastinaca caroli-kochii, commonly known as the Wild Carrot or Queen Anne's Lace, is a plant species in the carrot family (Apiaceae). It is traditionally used for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Pastinaca caroli-kochii include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which make it useful for treating conditions such as menstrual cramps, respiratory issues, and skin problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
